scope: Input RAW decoding required before pixel-shift reconstruction. Successful lossless and packed-14 checks do not establish high-efficiency support.

official_workflow.finding: The official pixel-shift guide recommends a high-efficiency RAW recording setting in its example shooting bank; high-efficiency inputs cannot be excluded by assuming pixel shift is lossless-only.
official_workflow.variant_finding: The guide permits HLG tone mode and image areas other than FX. These variants remain unverified by the present synthetic fixtures.

vendor_dispatch.compression_source: Nikon compression value parsed into frame+0x1ac; current Z8 sources expose it in MakerNote0x0051 bytes10..11.
vendor_dispatch.tico_wrapper_abi: Microsoft x64 bool(this_unused,input_byte_vector,width,height,output_uint16_vector). The wrapper configures its bundled decoder and copies a width*height uint16 output buffer after decoding.
vendor_dispatch.probe_boundary: The standalone research harness invokes the unmodified wrapper. It neither substitutes credentials nor changes the decoder's authorization checks.

public_samples.license: CC0 as listed by the public catalog
public_samples.sample_kind: Ordinary single-frame Z8 photographs, not pixel-shift captures. Catalog bit-depth labels are inconsistent; ExifTool reports14 bits in both files.
public_samples.metadata_limit: Firmware1.00 samples predate pixel-shift support and lack MakerNote0x005e. They can test codec access, not capture sequence semantics.

native_decoder_observation.both_results: LibRawFileUnsupportedError: Unsupported file format or not RAW file

native_decoder_20261030.implementation: src/ticoraw.cpp, commit 7b6ddce; dispatched from src/raw.cpp for Nikon compression 13 (HE) and 14 (HE*). Code 15, also routed to TicoRAW by the vendor dispatch above, remains rejected without a sample.
native_decoder_20261030.specification: https://github.com/lukaj99/ticoraw/blob/591714c55280c24b84bf83a2d3029e3d605443bd/docs/FORMAT.md, used as a format description only; no decoder code was copied.
native_decoder_20261030.camera_support: Official specifications list NEF (RAW) as 14-bit only with lossless, high efficiency* and high efficiency options for Z8, Zf, Z6III and Z5II; no other RAW recording precision exists for these models.

public_captures.manifest: ticoraw conformance/manifest.toml at 591714c; cfa_sha256 values are Adobe DNG Converter 18.7 (build 2743, -u -p0) mosaics
public_captures.result: All eight downloads match their published SHA-256. The native decoder and a live ticoraw 591714c decode (rustc 1.99.1) both reproduce every Adobe mosaic hash: 220,808,064 photosites, zero differences, 0.16 to 0.79 s per frame single-threaded.
public_captures.stream_observations: Every GCLI, data and sign sub-packet ends exactly at its declared length; constant-rate precincts end in zero padding only. The decoder requires both.

libraw_0_22_3.open: Succeeds for all eight captures with the expected geometry, crop, black 1008, maximum 16383, white balance and matrix; the Z5II matrix is absent as for lossless Z5II captures.
libraw_0_22_3.unpack: Z8, Zf and Z6III select nikon_he_load_raw by the FF10 FF50 strip signature and fail as unsupported. The Z5II is not in that model list: LibRaw selects nikon_load_raw, reads a lossless curve from file offset 0 at open, and unpack returns success with data errors over the TicoRAW bytes. cNEFX never unpacks HE strips.
libraw_0_22_3.calibration: Open-time color data equals LibRaw's unpack-time copy for lossless Z8 (ordinary and two authentic pixel-shift frames), Zf, Z6III and Z5II captures, so calibration is read at open for every capture.
libraw_0_22_3.small_file_limit: The Z5II open-time curve read covers up to 32 KiB near the file start and fails on smaller files; authored CI fixtures therefore carry a 36 KiB preview.

ci_fixtures.coverage: One sequence per model and capture count (Z8 4 HE, Zf 8 HE*, Z6III 16 HE, Z5II 32 HE*): 60 frames of 68x72 with two slices, odd band widths, random quantization, refinement, coding modes and padding. Each frame decode equals the pinned ticoraw decode and the fixture reconstruction; each merge equals the merge of a packed twin with the same samples. Six HE rejections check their reasons, and the CLI report names the HE limitation only for HE sequences.
ci_fixtures.mutations: Nine non-equivalent decoder mutations (wavelet and Star-Tetrix rounding and clamping, prediction mapping, dequantization, refinement pump, discarded-coefficient signs, insignificant vertical groups, output curve) all fail the fixtures; a real DX capture misses the discarded-sign mutation. Two candidate mutations were equivalent: high-pass inputs are multiples of 16, and the first-precinct reference reduces to GTLI.
ci_fixtures.runs: Release and ASan/UBSan CTest and tools/ci.py verify pass on the sources and tools of 489f848.
ci_fixtures.independent_review: A separate review fuzzed 100,000 mutated fixture strips and 60 mutated Z5II strips under ASan/UBSan without reports, and decoded 4,000 mutated codestreams with both decoders: no output differences and no stream accepted by cNEFX but rejected by ticoraw.

full_resolution_synthetic.construction: Authentic Z8 C 3.01 pixel-shift frames SGL_6243..SGL_6258 (16 frames, one AE exposure) with their RAW strip replaced by the public Z8 HE or HE* codestream, compression set to 13 or 14 and the lossless linearization table removed; packed twins carry the same ticoraw-decoded samples. Identical repeated RAW, not authentic HE captures.
full_resolution_synthetic.result: 16-to-1, 16-to-4 and corrected 16-to-1 merges of HE and HE* sequences equal their packed twins on all 545,292,288 RGB samples per case; --jobs 1 equals the default for 16-to-4. HE limitation appears only for HE sequences.
full_resolution_synthetic.resources: Executable 423f4cfdc217ff42eff83c23ec7ca35f167c9d4915e9017a8615432b80e3da78, built from 7b6ddce sources, default jobs on 16 threads: HE 11.1 to 13.6 s versus packed 9.8 to 12.5 s; peak RSS 2.61 versus 2.52 GB for 16-to-1 and 1.22 versus 1.06 GB for 16-to-4. Each concurrent HE decode holds four int32 component planes, about 4 bytes per photosite, in addition to the 2-byte output plane.

not_established: NX Studio merge of authentic HE/HE* pixel-shift captures: NEFX metadata for HE sources follows the lossless transformation, and HE sources lack the lossless NEFInfo 0x000e block, which is not recreated.
Whether NX Studio clips or otherwise normalizes decoded HE samples before merging.
Downstream white level: Adobe writes 15892 for HE captures, while NEFX from HE sources declares the same packed 14-bit layout as from lossless sources.
Public captures code every band with vertical prediction and no nonzero coefficient past a band end; zero prediction and discarded-coefficient signs rest on authored fixtures and ticoraw only.
Patent licensing for distributing builds that decode JPEG XS.
